ai_summary_zh: 【AI 3D 幾何與地面實景照片多模態判釋】本測區（QiHu_Merged_2026-10-28）經 TWD97 局部地形視窗裸地 DTM 分離、3D 樹幹圓柱斷面驗證（No Trunk = No Tree）與 88 張行動裝置 RTK 實景照片投影驗證：共識別出道路鋪面 6 處（平面面積 3,715.2 m²）、具實體樹幹之喬木 81 株（1.3m 胸高斷面 Pratt 圓擬合平均胸徑 DBH 24.7 cm）、水域與未建模水面空洞 2 處（面積 1,330.0 m²，靜水岸際基準高程 TWVD2001 +6.83 m）、以及垂直擋土牆/護岸結構 39 段（3D 垂直立面面積 899.4 m²）。
ai_summary_en: [Gemini Vision + 3D Trunk Cylinder & Ground Photo Referee] Multi-scale local DTM, strict 3D trunk cylinder slicing ('No Trunk = No Tree'), and 88 calibrated mobile phone photo projection(s) on 'QiHu_Merged_2026-10-28' verified 6 paved road corridor(s) (3,715.2 m² planar), 81 trunk-verified tree(s) (mean 1.3m breast-height DBH 24.7 cm via anti-webbing Pratt circle fit), 2 water basin / un-modelled canal void zone(s) (1,330.0 m² at hydrostatic shoreline TWVD2001 +6.83 m), and 39 retaining/structural wall segment(s) (899.4 m² true 3D vertical face area).
